name: artifact-hub
description: Artifact Hub for Claude Code: every artifact you publish, filed, searchable, and one keystroke away.

plugins.name: artifact-hub
plugins.description: Every Claude artifact you publish, filed, searchable, and one keystroke away: links saved on your machine at publish time, filed into project folders on one private index page with a command palette, gallery, search, details, status and a weekly digest.

plugins.name: artifact-hub-guard
plugins.description: Optional mod for Claude Code 2.1.287+: before a new artifact is published with a title your saved list already has, asks whether to update the existing page instead. Reads the main plugin's pages.json only; never blocks.
